verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-facing export of the cap table or transaction history to Excel/CSV. What it does show is alpha API endpoints for retrieving the cap table, stakeholders, option grants and convertible notes. Those are developer building blocks from which an export could be built, not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit. The Excel features in the Investors plugin cover fund budgets and financial statements, not cap table export, and no full transaction-history export is evidenced.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage
